title: 第十五章 虚界泰斗第十六章 杀猪盘
content_zh:
下午两点。
刘子文家里开的网吧包厢中。
两人都戴上了超梦头盔。
【正在加载中……】
【正在接入感官解码器……】
【正在编译着色器……】
【痛觉调整度为20%……】
王庆借用账号的角色，jk双马尾女高，再次来到素质大厅中。
每次登录都是随机节点。
上次的大厅是海边的石砌喷泉广场，这次则在一个金碧辉煌的宫殿建筑内。
周围全是猎奇或者顶美捏脸的人上蹿下跳。
别指望游戏内的人素质有多高，阴暗面都是要在网络上发泄的，不然上网干勾吧呢？
只要开了公共语音，听到其它角色说话全是消音屏蔽点草，要不是就是毫无营养的找对象或者直接性骚扰。
虽然阉割了性体验的物理碰撞，但仍然有部分角色围着女角色，隔着空气墙做出不雅动作。
王庆无语，手臂划动，唤出ui界面，等着刘子文的邀请。
【你的好友[钱是英雄胆]邀请你加入自定义房间。】
【留言：d姐已经进来了。】
刘子文倒是希望王庆能打赢。
王庆被暴虐的话，不仅输钱，并且自己也不能破除心魔，要是王庆把d姐都给打爆了，那么就说明不是自己的问题，自己的无敌势依然还在！重新get到道心！
但这可能么？那是本赛季全服前1000的虚界泰斗，21层里最猛的。

王庆同意了请求。
【场景加载中……】
这次房间的地图换成了其它场景，也是只有在游戏里才能做到的。
天幕万里无云，四周都是一望无垠的大海，并且波涛汹涌，只有脚下是青石打造的开阔正方形擂台。
刀房内一共三个人。
刘子文是在观战席，不参与比赛，擂台角落有着计算人头的比分板，现在的数据是0：0。
既然是红包局，那么比分就要白纸黑字的弄好。
王庆也看到了所谓d姐操控的角色。
明显感觉得到d姐是收入可观的人。
虚界是pvp竞技游戏，创收手段是外观付费。
王庆和刘子文都穿得相当普通，一个jk，一个半裸。
而d姐身上的衣服，没有点元子拿不下来。
这身衣服直购都买不到，要限时转盘抽奖大保底才能出，虚拟外观都要花一两万。
整体设计风格是版型贴合曲线的古典袍服，设计以广寒白与冰魄蓝为主，如同皓月清辉与寒冰交融披挂星河，两袖是冰晶棱块覆盖的手甲，粒子特效闪着冰川崩裂的寒气，
角色捏脸也是不知道哪套来的顶美捏脸模板，头发也是花钱买的白发外观。
“咦……啧啧，兄弟怎么玩个jk女高啊，有点痴汉……好恶。”
凌澜给出锐评。
“呵呵，排骨汤面啊？”
王庆毫不示弱。
刘子文喉咙滚了滚，装逼犯梗小鬼发力了，好嘲讽。

虚界玩家都是网瘾比较大的人，凌澜也是瞬间get到了梗，神他妈拍古装片！这是一直没返过场，前年的限定服装，你这审美……
“你和刘子文是一个大学的？”
“嗯呐。”
王庆研究着给凌澜下套，心中设定好了剧本，3败1胜，2败1胜，1败1胜，3败1胜，最后反复10胜1败给点机会，然后一直赚元子。
content_en:
2 p.m.
In the private room of the Internet cafe owned by Liu Ziwen.
Both men put on Mewtwo helmets.
【Loading...】
[Connecting to the sensory decoder...]
[Compiling shaders...]
[The pain adjustment degree is 20%...]
The character Wang Qing borrowed from his account, jk, a high school girl with twin ponytails, came to the Quality Hall again.
Each login is a random node.
The hall last time was a stone fountain square on the seaside, but this time it was in a splendid palace building.
There were people jumping up and down all around who were looking for novelties or looking for beauty.
Don't expect the quality of the people in the game to be very high. The dark side has to be vented on the Internet. Otherwise, why not do it online?
As long as the public voice is turned on, the words spoken by other characters are all muted and blocked, or they are simply looking for a partner or directly sexually harassing.
Although the physical collision of the sexual experience is castrated, some characters still surround the female characters and make indecent movements through the wall of air.
Wang Qing was speechless. He moved his arm to bring up the UI interface, waiting for Liu Ziwen's invitation.
[Your friend [Money is the Hero’s Guts] invites you to join the custom room. 】
[Message: Sister D has come in. 】
Liu Ziwen hoped that Wang Qing could win.
If Wang Qing is abused, he will not only lose money, but he will also be unable to get rid of his inner demons. If Wang Qing beats Sister D to death, then it means that it is not his problem, and his invincibility is still there! Get the Tao Heart again!
But is this possible? That is the top 1,000 virtual masters in the entire server this season, the most powerful in the 21st floor.
Wang Qing agreed to the request.
[Scene loading...]
This time the map of the room was changed to another scene, which can only be done in the game.
The sky is cloudless, surrounded by the endless sea with rough waves, and only the open square arena made of bluestone is beneath your feet.
There were three people in the knife room.
Liu Ziwen was in the audience seat and did not participate in the game. There was a scoreboard in the corner of the ring that counted heads. The current data was 0:0.
Since it is a red envelope game, the score must be settled in black and white.
Wang Qing also saw the role controlled by the so-called Sister D.
It is obvious that Sister D is a person with a considerable income.
Virtual Realm is a PVP competitive game, and the means of generating revenue is appearance payment.
Both Wang Qing and Liu Ziwen were dressed quite ordinary, one was a dick and the other was half-naked.
And there was nothing Motoko couldn't take off the clothes on Sister D.
You can't buy this outfit directly. You have to draw a lottery for a limited time to get it with a big guarantee. The virtual appearance will cost ten thousand or twenty thousand.
The overall design style is a classical robe that fits the curves. The design is mainly in Guanghan white and ice blue, just like the clear light of the bright moon blending with the ice and draping the stars. The two sleeves are gauntlets covered with ice crystal prisms, and the particle special effects shine with the cold air of the glacier collapse.
The character's face is made from a beautiful face template that I don't know where, and the hair is also bought with money to look like white hair.
"Eh... tsk tsk, brother, why are you playing a JK girl? You are a bit crazy... likes and dislikes."
Ling Lan gave a sharp comment.
"Haha, pork ribs noodle soup?"
Wang Qing showed no signs of weakness.
Liu Ziwen's throat rolled, and the brat who was pretending to be a bitch was showing off his strength, so mocking.
Players in Virtual Realm are all very addicted to the internet, and Ling Lan instantly got the idea that he was making a costume movie! This is a limited edition costume from the year before last that I have never returned to. With your aesthetic...
"You and Liu Ziwen are from the same university?"
"Yeah."
Wang Qing studied how to trick Ling Lan, and set up a script in his mind: 3 losses and 1 win, 2 losses and 1 win, 1 loss and 1 win, 3 losses and 1 win, and finally repeated 10 wins and 1 loss to give some opportunities, and then kept making money.
